name: BK-EDMA
summary: 3,4-Ethylenedioxymethcathinone, also known as EDMC or 3,4-ethylenedioxy-N-methylcathinone, is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA) of the phenethylamine, EDxx, and cathinone families related to methylone (3,4-methylenedioxymethcathinone; MDMC). It is the β-keto or cathinone analogue of 3,4-ethylenedioxymethamphetamine (EDMA).

pharmacology.text: 3,4-Ethylenedioxymethcathinone, also known as EDMC or 3,4-ethylenedioxy-N-methylcathinone, is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA) of the phenethylamine, EDxx, and cathinone families related to methylone (3,4-methylenedioxymethcathinone; MDMC). EDMC acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

uses.en: It is a research chemical with no medical use, studied for how it releases monoamines, and it has appeared as a designer drug.
uses.zh: 它是研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，因釋放單胺類的機制而被研究，並曾以設計師藥物的形式出現。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究化学品，没有医疗用途，因释放单胺类的机制而被研究，并曾以设计师药物的形式出现。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety, overheating and psychosis, and carry a high risk of compulsive redosing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮、體溫過高與精神病，並有高度的強迫性連續補用風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、失眠、焦虑、体温过高与精神病，并有高度的强迫性连续补用风险。

fact.en: It is methylone with its five membered dioxole ring widened to a six membered dioxine, one carbon larger. Chemists call this the EDxx family, as against the more familiar MDxx one.
fact.zh: 它是把 methylone 的五員二氧雜環擴大為六員二氧雜環、多出一個碳的產物。化學家稱這類為 EDxx 家族，以區別於較熟悉的 MDxx 家族。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 methylone 的五员二氧杂环扩大为六员二氧杂环、多出一个碳的产物。化学家称这类为 EDxx 家族，以区别于较熟悉的 MDxx 家族。
